name: carnitine palmitoyl transferase II deficiency, severe infantile form
description: The severe infantile form of carnitine palmitoyltransferase II (CPT II) deficiency, an inherited disorder that affects mitochondrial oxidation of long chain fatty acids (LCFA), is the early-onset form of the disease.
